slides.title: The big idea
slides.html:
Indirect measurement finds lengths we cannot reach by using similar or congruent triangles.

Shadow method: at the same moment, the Sun's rays make equal angles with level ground everywhere nearby, so a person and a building with their shadows form similar right triangles (AA). If a 1.8 m student casts a 2.4 m shadow while the gym casts a 16 m shadow, the gym is h with h/16 = 1.8/2.4, so h = 12 m.

Congruent triangles work too: pace out a triangle on land congruent to one across a river.
